newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Pennacchi denies she said 1,020 lire for ERM.
newsitem.headline: Italy Pennacchi denies she said 1,020 lire for ERM.

text.p: The undersecretary at the Italian Treasury Laura Pennacchi in a note denied every statement that had been attributed to her "concerning the fixation of the exchange rate at 1,020 lire against the German mark".
Her note refered to remarks supposedly attributed to her that the lira would enter Europe's Exchange Rate Mechanism at a rate of 1,020 lire to the mark.

"The will to re-enter the ERM has been stated many times clearly by the prime minister and the treasury minister, and it was confirmed by me in the meeting I had yesterday with the news agency Knight Ridder Financial/Europe," Pennacchi said.
"I deny, however, most categorially every statement attributed to me concerning the fixing of the lira at 1,020 in respect to the exchange rate with the German mark," she added in her statement.
